resources.string: Test tools, for test builds only
Test builds only. Open it from Settings > Diagnostic, or by holding one finger down for 10 seconds anywhere in the app.
An account is signed in on this phone: this test would sign it out. Sign out first (Settings > My account), then run the test.
Careful: these switches change the real choices of this phone (usage measurement and crash reports), the same ones as in Settings > Privacy.
